classification.difficultyReason: Use equal-side markings to form and solve a perimeter equation.

content.prompt: Find the missing length in these shapes. The perimeter is given.

spec.description: Unshaded inverted isosceles triangle with a horizontal top, matching double ticks on its descending sides and the unknown label on the right side.
spec.mathematics: The top side is 10 mm; both remaining sides have length x mm. The perimeter is 46 mm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and equality marks are visible; the supplied answer is stored separately.

answer.worked:
$\begin{align*}P &= 10+x+x\\46 &= 10+2x\\36 &= 2x\\18 &= x\end{align*}$
The missing length is $18\text{ mm}$.

spec.description: Unshaded convex quadrilateral with a horizontal bottom, vertical right edge, sloping left edge and a top edge descending towards the upper-right vertex. Matching double ticks remain on the top and left edges. Only the lower-right vertex has a right-angle square.
spec.mathematics: Top and left sides are marked equal to x m; bottom is 13 m, right side is 7 m, and perimeter is 39 m. Thus 39 = 2x + 20 and x = 9.5 m. The corrected geometry satisfies all retained relationships.
spec.answerVisibility: All source numerical givens and equal-side ticks remain visible; the supplied answer is stored separately. The upper-right right-angle mark alone is removed by explicit human decision.
spec.authorizedDeparture: The human decision authorizes removing only the source upper-right right-angle mark and redrawing a geometrically valid quadrilateral with its top descending towards the upper-right vertex. Original source evidence is preserved. The lower-right right angle, perimeter, measurements, equality relationships, external 47 mm width, font declaration and manual overrides remain unchanged.

geometryVerification.construction: B is the upper intersection of radius-9.5 circles centred at A and C. With d = sqrt(218) and h = sqrt(35.75), B = (6.5 - 7h/d, 3.5 + 13h/d). Drawing coordinates use the uniform scale 3.1/13.
geometryVerification.verification: Both marked sides equal 9.5 m; the perimeter is 39 m; DA is horizontal and DC vertical; B is above C and left of C, so BC descends to the right. The rounded TikZ coordinates preserve these lengths within 0.000000001 m.

answer.worked:
$\begin{align*}P &= x+x+7+13\\39 &= 2x+20\\19 &= 2x\\9.5 &= x\end{align*}$
The perimeter equation gives $x=9.5\text{ m}$.

spec.description: Unshaded square-shaped quadrilateral with matching single ticks on all four sides and x km beside the right side.
spec.mathematics: All four sides have length x km and the perimeter is 26 km.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and equality marks are visible; the corrected supplied answer is stored separately.

answer.worked:
$\begin{align*}P &= x+x+x+x\\26 &= 4x\\6.5 &= x\end{align*}$
The missing length is $6.5\text{ km}$.
